system.description:
Requirements: Training (1) in Performance

You can inspire others with stirring wounds or music.

  • You have a number of motivation points equal to your Soul.

  • Once per round, you can expend a motivation point to encourage another creature as a Free Action on your turn.

  • If you do so, that creature gains +1 bonus dice to the next check it makes within the next 1 hour.

  • You replenish your motivation points after you finish a Long Rest.
